build_biknn_radius_graph: build a biknn radius graph for a batch of atomic systems using the biknn_radius_graph function
build_chunked_radius_graph: build a chunked radius graph for one system using build_radius_graph_chunked to reduce peak memory
compute_soft_ranks: compute soft ranks for a single padded segment using compute_soft_ranks_single_segment with vmap compatibility
run_segment_argsort: run a vectorized segment argsort on values grouped by segment IDs using segment_argsort_vectorized
run_batched_radius_graph: run batched radius graph construction across multiple systems using batched_radius_graph with optional chunking
